name: Image Editor
author: FryPDF Team
description: Professional layered design and photo editing studio: modular docking workspace, inpainting Remove tool, Curves, Liquify, Shadows/Highlights, Black & White adjustments, text warp, Grd/Abr/Patterns and FITS/PCX/KRA codecs, OpenType typography, layers panel, and template gallery.
releaseNotes: 100% PhotoCraft and Photoshop UI visual parity update: two-tier right dock architecture with flat rectangular panel styling, exact tab strip geometry and typography (Brushes/Navigator/Properties/Histogram/Color + Channels/Paths/History/Actions/Layers), enhanced Color panel with swap/reset chips and hex readout, refined Navigator with camera viewport preview and zoom presets, and updated Paths/Channels action footers.

DefaultBackground.label: Default Canvas Background
DefaultBackground.description: Starting canvas background color when the editor opens.
